who.en: Do you know who that boy is?
who.cn: 你知道那个男孩是谁吗？

he.en: He is a good friend of mine.

she.en: She is the new English teacher.

friend.en: I have many friends at school.
A good friend is hard to find.

teacher.en: The English teacher tells us a funny story.
teacher.cn: 英语老师给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。

classmate.en: My classmate sits next to me.
All my classmates are very friendly.
classmate.cn: 我所有的同学都很友好。

boy.en: The boy in red is my brother.
boy.cn: 穿红衣服的男孩是我弟弟。

boy.en: That boy can play the piano very well.
boy.cn: 那个男孩钢琴弹得很好。

girl.en: The girl with long hair is Lily.
Every girl in our class likes to dance.
girl.cn: 我们班的每个女孩都喜欢跳舞。
